notes.title: October News : Wrapping up the Kickstarter... Back to development!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re back from vacation, bursting with energy, and excited to start sending out Kickstarter rewards and continue working on Cat Cafe Manager 2! ✨

On Kickstarter,  we managed to collect a whopping 88,957 EUR from 2,063 backers - thank you all SO SO much! With this money, we won't just be able to create the game of our dreams; we will also be in the position to add the following Stretch Goals: Customizing your cafe’s outside, Cat Connections, Romanceable NPCs, and Kittens! 😻

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/b3e5d01dcdb13079ff6ef1667944bbc07f7737da.png

We also managed to unlock two extra hearts of the Community Goals with more than 2,000 Kickstarter backers and 400 TikTok followers, which means, we’ve unlocked the adorable 🍌 Banana cat hat!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/5cb409a57807dacbb59d8077a859ddc2628fca0c.png

Update on CCM2 Development:

Hi, a quick word from game designer Rick here! We spent the last couple of months fully focused on the Kickstarter campaign, making sure we could show you just how pretty the game is going to look. However, that also means it's been a while since we actually worked on its gameplay, which will be our main focus in the months to come! Programmer Ernst and I will be diving back into Unity, the engine we use to build our game in. Time to fire those game development ovens back up! 🧑‍🍳🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/98290c56e6b0ccd9360bdf7a7ba66aa59d3ff6c4.png

Ernst will focus his efforts on enhancing our development toolset, which will allow us to build the game more quickly and smoothly in the future. Rick will be planning the order of all gameplay elements so we can decide which ones should be built first. It's safe to say that these are super exciting times on the game development front! 👀

We will be back next month with more updates about the development of Cat Cafe Manager 2!

Don’t hesitate to reach out to us on Discord, Reddit, Twitter, TikTok or Instagram if you have any questions about the survey or anything else! Thank you so much!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/d6ccc5f5516032e9acb3c7b4cc857d1787908745.png

For now, we want to wish you a very spooky Halloween from Finley, Boo-Berry and everyone at Roost Games!! 🧙‍♀️

- Irene & Claire

notes.title: 🌟 Last few hours of the Kickstarter! Next Stretch Goal: 😻Kittens!
notes.content:
Hello, we're approaching the end of the campaign and we have already reached the 70k€ stretch goal!!!! 🙀 😭 


 €50K unlocked: 🏪 Cafe Outside Customization
 €60K unlocked: 🐱 Cat Connections
 €70K unlocked: 💌 Romanceable NPCs

This means that a bunch of characters will become romanceable! Get ready for gift-giving, cute dates, and unique story content for each romanceable NPC! 💌 🥰 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/d6973864c05461f3a66bcff68c07e858b0e49798.png

If we meet the next stretch goal at €80k (88,205 USD) we will include... Kittens in the game! 😻 

🙀 These tiny furballs require a little more care than your average feline... but aren't they CUTE?

💪 Kittens start off with lower stats than most cats, but can become very good little kittens if you spend the time & resources to nurture them.

💖 If certain specific cats get close... your cat cafe might be blessed with a new kitten soon! Be sure to take good care of the parents, too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/e05ed7202aae14d4ef4d8aeaae0baa38856db360.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/cbb31e57bc72876de58d4c4ed734a3a6430a5291.png

We also wanted to share some details about the 🐟😻 Adopting stray cats mechanic!

🧭 Finding a stray cat for the first time will add it to your 📀 Cat-o-Dex.
Different strays will appear in different places. If you forget where you found one, you can easily check your Cat-o-Dex!

🌦️ Some strays will only appear under certain conditions, such as a specific time of day or weather. But don't worry, kind folks in town might give you hints on how to find rare stray cats! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/9faf32fec03fc7c02ed75ba5edb11a590329b9c1.png

Once you find a stray, you can approach them and start a 🐟😻 Stray Encounter!

These are turn-based encounters where each turn, you decide how to approach the stray. Try to win their Trust without startling them!

✋ Petting a stray cat is a great way to earn lots of Trust, but it may cause them to get skittish and run away!

🥫 Most cats can't resist the allure of cat food. If they look ready to run, lure them back in with their favorite treat.

🐱 Some of your Cat Companions can also help! Having them cuddle and play with the stray can put the them at ease and win their Trust!

For this mechanic, we got inspired by the Pokémon safari zone and other pacifist turn-based RPGs. I hope you look forward to finding all the stray cats and winning their trust!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/cbb31e57bc72876de58d4c4ed734a3a6430a5291.png

Here's a sneak peek of the Wallpapers  that backers of the 😎COOL CAT tier or above will receive in a few weeks! They will be available in different sizes so you can use them for different screen types and devices! 💖

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/7b7c96e9e38af7ee76057d347afc3458f2ac8b4c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/cbb31e57bc72876de58d4c4ed734a3a6430a5291.png

Finally, we're currently running a new pet contest on X/Twitter and on Discord! We will add one lucky pet to the game, in one way or another. To participate, you can send us your pet picture(s) on this X/Twitter thread or on Discord. We will pick the winner this weekend!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/accae42a0c41974afe49570a92d1a1e88286b338.jpg

We will be back with another update soon after the campaign is done, to let you know how much we were able to raise, and what the next steps of development will be.

If you want to keep an eye yourself to see if we reach the Kittens stretch goal, you can head directly over to our Kickstarter page.

THANKS SO MUCH EVERYONE!! 

Until then! <3

- Irene and the team at Roost Games

This also means we've already unlocked 2 🚩Stretch Goals:

 €50K : 🏪 Cafe Outside Customization
 €60K : 🐱 Cat Connections🚩🏪 Cafe Outside Customization
With this feature you won't just get to decorate the inside of your cafe, but also customize your cat cafe's outside: colors, decorations, windows, plants, signage, and furniture!

Cat Connections will see cats in your cafe build connections as they spend time together!

notes.title: A Mini-Update to celebrate the Cat Cafe Manager 2 Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Hi there!

We've just launched the Kickstarter campaign to help fund Cat Cafe Manager 2's development, and we couldn't be more excited!! ❤️It would help us a lot if you could back the campaign as soon as you can, as the first hours are the most important! Thanks so much!!❤️

To celebrate, we're launching a little mini-update for Cat Cafe Manager 1!

Introducing: Faeline Lore!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/c7a5f6710bb0c436396f36eb124f87c8dbb8bb5b.png
This old repository of ancient lore will significantly raise your cafe's Book Score, which I know has been a tough stat to boost up 'till now! You can purchase Faeline Lore at the Decoration section of the Furniture Shop! It's not exactly cheap, but definitely worth it!

But what is a Faeline, exactly? In short, they're adorable little feline faeries. They haven't been seen by humans in many years, but cats see and interact with them all the time. Faeline will also feature prominently in the sequel, Cat Cafe Manager 2! Check out the Kickstarter page for more details!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/90fb46bfb617fcdc5b64f2e4832548e47ed4486e.png

Finally, I want to give a massive thank you to you, the players of Cat Cafe Manager 1!
Without you playing and supporting the game, we never could have started production on a sequel. We're dedicated to make it bigger, better and fluffier without losing the cozy cafe experience you've come to love! ❤️

Again, please take a look at the Kickstarter, and if you can, help support the development of Cat Cafe Manager 2 by backing.

Thanks so much!
- Rick (and all of Roost Games

notes.title: Cat Cafe Manager 2 : July Monthly Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here’s our monthly update!

Last month we announced that we are working on a sequel of our first game, called Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss, and we are running a Kickstarter campaign in September! We reached 1000 followers in less than 3 weeks!! So exciting!! Thanks so much everyone!! 😱

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/65ed9b5613689e1d7bc36b033cd95dd8fa80581b.png

Remember that Kickstarter works a bit like Steam: the more followers we can get before it launches, the better the algorithm likes us, the better chances we have of the campaign becoming a big success! So please give us a follow and let your friends know, if you haven’t done so yet! 😺

By the way, something important to keep in mind is that when the campaign goes live in September, in order to pledge and support us you must use a debit or credit card associated with Visa, Discover, JCB, MasterCard, UnionPay, or American Express. Kickstarter does not currently accept Maestro or Visa Electron cards, PayPal or Klarna. Please keep this in mind in case you don’t have a debit or credit card yet, so that you might be able to order one before the campaign goes live. Or maybe you can lend you one from a friend to help you out with their card! (That’s what I do). You can find more detail about payment options here. 🙏

Call Me, Maybe?
It was so exciting for everyone in the team to finally reveal what we’re working on and show the key art of our next game! How do you like it, and did you have a closer look at all the small details?

Especially keen-eyed viewers of the Cat Cafe Manager 2 art might notice your main character holding something... a smartphone! Gone are the days of having to walk over to your pay-phone every day. With this newfangled gadget, you can do all kinds of neat stuff!

Here's a sneak-peek image of an early design for the phone menu. Using your smartphone, you can access different kinds of menus or look up handy info.
And what a cute accessory!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/4189c13c3b27cc26fff6dd3a6f4c75cab98f092a.png

Please note: none of what's presented here is final, including the design, as well as the buttons that are present on the smartphone. Thanks for understanding.

Introducing The Cat Cafe Team!

Today I also wanted to present to you our team. We're currently working very hard on Cat Cafe Manager 2 and preparing the Kickstarter campaign, so that we will be able to show you the first images next month, stay tuned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/27227ab1a17c7fdbd757d7e0d249c60a737badd1.png
Rick first saw a cat cafe in 2013 during his exchange study in Kyoto and couldn't help but think "heck, this might make for a good game!". 7 years and 3 released games later (look for Abbey Games) he started Roost Games to finally make that cat cafe game! Rick's the game designer and story person on Cat Cafe Manager, and the Creative Director on Cat Cafe Manager 2. He might be addicted to board games, and won't let his allergies stop him from petting every dog and cat he lays his eyes on.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/2f5143235117c6ee3947f236fb7b5ac4fa2d92e9.png
Carmen has been a part of Roost Games since the very beginning in 2020 and worked on Cat Cafe Manager as an art director, artist and animator. She’s worked as an artist/animator on several indie titles such as Renowned Explorers, Reus 2 and Tracks of Thought. She’s a big time Sailor Moon fan and is still waiting for the day a talking cat tells her she has magical moon powers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/1dca132470b5a4de9de443bcc3adf286899a3c35.png
Joni has been part of Roost Games since 2020 and as a producer and business developer he usually only plays a small part, but in a lot of different things. In the past he also made music, and besides music and games he loves Legos, good food, and cats of course - although he is sadly in between cats at the moment…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/eb3ee0c383b728f9bfe87d4c9cf2d4dc7667ae17.png
Esmeé is a Game Artist/Designer and advocate for the cozy games genre. She directed the 2.5D game Tracks of Thought where she worked with some of the Cat Cafe Manager 2 crew before! Now as one of their freelancers she’s responsible for all the bits, pieces and buttons making up the interface for the game as well as helping with marketing efforts. She takes great pride in befriending all the cats in her neighbourhood and hopes to save a bee with some sugar water someday.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/2d1c990a7bd3674e142c1693bbdc570ce10cb443.png
Ernst is a long time collaborator and since 2024 officially part of Roost Games. As the main game programmer for Cat Cafe Manager 2, he makes sure all the game design ideas and art are transformed into a real game. Besides programming and playing games, he likes to cook, read fantasy novels and is a bit of a coffee snob. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/f6b0984deb3ad36911edaaae680c009b97ed7787.png
Mischa is a game artist working in both 2D and 3D. He also made a tiny game called ‘Little Man has a Day’ so he can call himself a gamedev as well. As a freelancer working on Cat Cafe Manager 2, he was responsible for turning Carmen’s 2D drawings and designs into 3D objects. When he’s not behind his computer making things, he dabbles in amateur theater, but would never admit that on the internet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/004e6ceed03d152516d00b99581d11f87db2f6f2.png
Sonya is a musician, game composer and cat-fan. She officially joined roost games 2 years ago after working on Cat Cafe Manager as a freelancer. She’s been making music in very many shapes and forms, playing on big music festivals as a bass player, recording bands as an engineer and even scoring a theater piece using all sound of a piano except for the piano keys. Sonya has had a lot of long conversations with her cat Vosje about how cat music should sound so she’s really looking forward to putting all this new information into practice!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/6f9e08cefad7d1c041744dbdb67fcac890a0c1a8.png
Tim joined Roost Games as a freelancer earlier this year and is taking care of the tech art, meaning he's creating effects and tools to make the game prettier! He has his own indie game studio, where he created Garden Buddies and the upcoming Footsy, and has also helped on the game Tracks of Thought. He loves playing music, is obsessed with Japanese monster movies, and loves to make pretty shaders! One of his first 3D models was actually (a VERY rough) model of his childhood cat! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/13968252cfeb700bad8251a3751ede8880d02c20.png
Irene joined Roost Games earlier this year to take care of Marketing and Community, she worked on the indie games Kraken Academy and Suzerain before. She sadly has no cats due to allergies, but has a lot of plants instead! 🌱

Let's Wrap Up

thanks so much for playing our little cat game!

notes.title: Update #1: The Comfy Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/ef323603df9d868b5cc474a9aab2c01ea7e732ae.png

Hullo there!
Are your feet up? Is your blankie all the way up to your chin? Hot coco and a purring cat nearby?
That's right, get comfy for the ✨Comfy Update✨, the first big update for Cat Cafe Manager!

The Comfy Update
First of all, I want to quickly thank each and every one of you that played Cat Cafe Manager! It's been a dream come true for us, a tiny 4 person studio, to see you enjoying the game, and telling us how you feel about it.
On that note, I also really want to thank everyone that shared feedback, suggestions and bug reports with us on our Discord and the Steam forum! It's been sooo helpful in determining what we can do to make Cat Cafe Manager a more relaxing, comfy experience for you!

This update is all about quality of life! Giving you the tools to play CCM better and easier.
Let's comfortably slide right into the patch notes, shall we?

🐱 Points with this icon were Community Suggestions!

NEW FEATURES

 🐱 You can now sell your unwanted furniture in Decorate Mode!
In the Decorate UI, select the piece of furniture you want to sell, and click the blue 'Sell' box. You'll get back 25% of the price you paid for the furniture!
 🐱 You can now select which tasks a Staff member will perform.
You can set them in the 'detail screen' for a Staff Member by checking or unchecking the little box next to a skill. This allows you to focus Staff Members on only serving customers, or only cooking food.
 🐱 Added new Traits for Staff members which unlock the Cat Care and Maintenance skills.
 🐱 You can now edit your character and cafe name while playing.
Simply press ESC to go to the menu, which now has 2 new options: Edit Character & Edit Cafe Name.
 Added a new Gameplay option to single press a key/button instead of holding it to perform actions.
Go to Settings > Game, and tick the 'Tap to Perform Task' box there.

UI ADDITIONS

 🐱 The Autosave file now includes the player name so you can have Autosaves of multiple games, and the game warns you if you start a game with the same name, to prevent accidentally overwriting it.
 When a Customer Group levels up (after getting a Friendship Level with a Regular) a new screen will tell you what their new rewards and Needs are.
 🐱 Added arrow keys as valid control option for moving your character and camera for left-handed players.
 Food Menu UI now displays your recipe inventory and the recipes you're currently missing that your customers sometimes want to order.
 🐱 The Cat Roster UI now shows your total score per Customer Group, so you can more easily determine which Customers will be happy with your cat roster.
 You can now open the Cat Roster UI when petting stray cats.
 🐱 The Advertising UI now shows all the Needs and desired recipes of customers.
 Clearer indication when a Stray Lure cannot attract more Strays, and that Lure is removed from the shop. You'll also automatically get a refund on any Lures you own that can no longer attract Strays.
 🐱 Added icons for furniture style to the Shop and Decorate Mode, so you can see how much of a style you own.
 🐱 Added sorting options to the Shop UI. Sort based on name (A>Z), price (low>high), furniture style or amount owned (least>most).
 🐱 Added a number of how many of an ingredient you own in the Ingredient Shop, so you can more easily add the ones you need. (Tip: sort by 'amount owned' to see what you own the least of!)
 🐱 You now get a notification whenever a piece of equipment breaks.
 🐱 Added a button to show walls in Decorate mode, so you can easily move / remove windows and doors.
 🐱 The shops now show how many of an item you already have in your inventory.
 Added a line in the shop clarifying that a Stat won't get added when you already have one of that piece of furniture in your cafe (duplicates don't add stats, except for Cat Needs like Toy & Food, and Toilets for customers).
 Explanation in the reward screen when you get a Stray Lure as a present, that it is, in fact, a Lure.
 🐱 You can now skip the customer count at the end of the day by clicking.
 🐱 Fixed some readability issues in the Forever Home rewards.
 Improved how traits are displayed, especially when you have a lot of traits.
 Added some more indicators for controls to the Decorate Mode.
 🐱 Serving food Tasks are now yellow instead of orange, so you can more easily see which Customers are waiting for orders to be delivered.

BALANCE

 Kitchen tasks now spawn at the closest possible kitchen appliance, instead of randomly, better allowing for multiple kitchens.
 🐱 Customers with a "Comfort" need now automatically pick the most comfortable free chair available.
 Staff now prioritizes rarer tasks like maintenance, cat care and cleaning, if they're able to perform those.
 Made almost all traits a little more effective.
 🐱 End of the game story now triggers when the shrine is actually fully completed.

FIXES

 Fixed some traits not applying their bonus correctly.
 Fixed some stats overlapping in the UI.
 🐱 Fixed a few bugs related to relationship levels not displaying correctly.
 🐱 Fixed the Cat HUD in the lower right sometimes shifting left and hiding cats when you had a lot of cats.
 🐱 Fixed dialogue skipping when you were holding down a button when the dialogue popped up.

If you have any questions about the update, be sure to fire away at us on our Discord or the Steam forum! We'll try to answer asap!

Thanks!!
- Rick

notes.title: Dev Diary 6 (11/17) Tying It All Up
notes.content:
Join our discord to hear about new Dev Diaries as soon as they go up!

Hello dearest cat enthusiast!
We've been real hard at work on Cat Cafe Manager and we've got a few exciting developments to talk about! 

The last month had but one major theme: tying it all together!
This involves lots and lots of playing of the game, making balance changes, and fixing bugs as they pop up. This seems like a wild thing to say, but we actually managed to play Cat Cafe Manager from start to finish... for the very first time this month!

We gave our main menu a lick of paint. We wanted it to feel just as chill as hanging out with a cat that’s not even really paying attention to you.

notes.content:

Hello dearest cat enthusiast!

First and foremost, Cat Cafe Manager is going to be apart of Wholesome Direct!
Tune in on Saturday June 12th, at 1 pm EST to see all the wholesome games, including Cat Cafe Manager! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/f133f3c4bcb677ec074e8bb80366d0ca4dbe4b49.png

New Cats, Lures, Traits, and UI! Oh My! 
Some of our biggest improvements since the last update have been on our loveable cats and how you get those cats. 
We've added 5 new cats, like Lazy, a sleepy Norwegian Forest cat, or Mingus, who is definitely a cat and not just a raccoon that broke into the cat cafe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/ac9ccac1046e34f849d5f99a813a400c094dcdc1.png
Most definitely not a raccoon. Just your average cat in a cat cafe heh *looks around nervously*

We've also made a whole bunch of personality traits for your cats and staff which affect their stats and behaviors. A cat might be a ‘groomer’ that cleans up other cats, a ‘hunter’ that finds its own food and doesn’t have to be fed, or a ‘chonker’ who eats more than most but is extra cute because of it.

With this, there is now an expanded ‘lure’ system: lures are placed outside of your cafe and used to win the trust of stray cats. There’s now more than 10, and each lures in different stray cats for you to win over. The rarest ones are extra weird!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/183aaac7ac8e71d5f9ef1530ad1f9a6d65a6de58.png
What sort of cat could possibly be lured in by a chunk of fallen meteorite?

There's also a new 'Advertising’ interface, which allows you to put up advertising to control which types of customers visit. Different customer types pay in different resources, so use this wisely to earn what you need to meet your goals!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/2cd20fc795772b5b758060614195dcef6c409342.png
Want to expand your cafe? Advertise to ‘punks’, who pay in ‘materials’ needed for construction.

Some other small updates: 

 Working with our new audio partner and hearing the first pieces of Cat Cafe Manager music! Nothing to show off just yet, but very exciting nonetheless.
 You can now rotate all your props and decorations: giving you even more control over the look and feel of your cat cafe.
 Worked on improving the control scheme for the game, allowing you to run around the cafe, pet cats and serve your customers much more smoothly and directly.
 Created a new UI celebrating when you earn new rewards, such as receiving a present from a friend or adopting a new cat. This is also where you get to name your newly adopted cats.

For now, I hope you'll continue to look forward to Cat Cafe Manager! Don't forget to wishlist the game, if you haven't already and share with your friends!
Thanks for reading!

Roost Games’ Rick

notes.title: Dev Diary 2 (09/28) : A Shifting Game
notes.content:
Join our discord to hear about new Dev Diaries as soon as they go up!

Hi again dear cat enthusiast!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/1c4e9e9b23226d3bf666cf2d782314271ad744e9.png
It’s been a bit, hasn’t it? It's cause we've been real hard at work on Cat Cafe Manager and we've got some big exciting developments to talk about!

Shifting Shifts!
The biggest change we’ve recently made has been to the game’s Shifts.
Back when we released the teaser trailer the game had 2 clear phases: the ‘management’, and 'shift' phase. You made big management choices in the paused management phase and ran your cafe by ordering staff in the real-time shift phase.

While this sounded great on paper, it turned out this caused the game to be nowhere as chill and relaxing as we’d liked. To keep the shift interesting, we either had to tune it so you were constantly doing something (not very chill OR relaxing!), or have you wait around staring at your cafe going about its merry business before you could make management decisions again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/296dab1b80fe470ed5b37a2121fc02d107ab3743.png
Ha ha just playing my relaxing cat game ha ha *sweating profusely*

We decided to scrap those two phases and, much like the ill-considered bacon-and-cereal breakfast, just smash the two together! And just like that seemingly appalling meal, the results were unexpectedly delicious…

If you start up the dev build of Cat Cafe Manager now, the game’s clock is always ticking (unless you decide to pause it) and you can make ‘management’ decisions (expanding your cafe, changing up the menu) and 'shift' decisions (directing a poor soul to go mop up that cat wee in the corner) at any time you'd like.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/3e85c5e821cd604de6edd2ff5f24abff38f7db76.gif
While the cafe is open, pop into Build Mode to pop down a fridge

This might seem like a pretty small change, but it had a huge impact! It removed a lot of waiting from the game (you no longer have to wait for the Shift to end to go buy that new scratching post you were eyeing) and results in a much more organic and relaxed pace.

You can go make big important management decisions while your staff is serving your customers, although you might have to hop in and directly order them around when things get hairy!

Cat Adoption!
We’ve been working on so much more stuff, though!
First up: Rick (who refers to himself in the third person?) finished up the Cat Adoption mechanic, ready to be polished up at a later time.

Buy cat food from Carla-Lalla’s pet emporium and place it outside your cafe to attract stray cats. Different cat food attracts different cats. To adopt the truly strange mythical cats which roam the woods around Caterwaul, you’ll have to get pretty creative with your food choices!

When a stray pops by and eat the food, they’ll gain a little bit of Trust. You can also send one of your staff (preferably that cat-whisperer with the really high ‘Cat Care’ skill!) to go pet and befriend the stray, gaining a big Trust boost.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/79dac07e60d73f3d6e7840c8f00c65117a81b9dd.gif
Hello cool stray cat! Bye, cool stray cat! (Work in Progress, unpolished gameplay)

Once a cat's Trust bar is full,  they decide to come hang out at the cafe, and you get to adopt and name them! Some cats are tougher to adopt than others, and will require many visits and their favorite food to win their trust.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/9dcf602fdb50834f56c2185e2342a16140812cd8.png

Assigning Staff!
Rutger worked hard on the staff assignment UI.
Click on a staff member, or their icon in your HUD, to go into their Assignment Mode. This will highlight the different tasks that need doing: from cleaning a toilet to calming down a cat with zoomies. Simply click the task and they’ll go do it!

Each staff has different skill ratings, so better make sure to hire staff for all the different tasks in your cafe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/cd171922b96498a4d0fe5ca83ea236515553dabf.gif
Someone's got to do it, right?

Oh, and your staff can do tasks all on their own if you can buy a nice hat! Different hats correspond to different activities, so a chef hat will cause a staff member to cook up a storm without having to manually tell them to do so!

Bring in the Cats!
Carmen’s also been hard at work making more cute cats and cat animations!
I’ll just let them speak for themselves.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/6e0d6eda8872b857dae430279701e0806cf95a46.gif

Much more!?
Turns out writing a dev diary after a two-month break is really hard because we’ve just made so much stuff in the meantime! A lot of it is still in progress, like Rutger’s rad new lighting system, Rick’s improvements to the game’s mailbox and shops or Carmen’s new town map and beautiful cat shrine.

I guess we’ll show them off another day...
OK Fine Calm Down here's a GIF and a screenshot
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/44d244183cdefbe4f554d7148c447a1112ed8e25.gif
Work in progress, mind!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/f26158f92378acbd85c7c1494699d6f99b1a6e7e.png
The shrine is almost ready for you to renovate!

For now, I hope you'll continue to look forward to Cat Cafe Manager!
Thanks for reading!

Roost Games’ Rick

notes.title: Dev Diary 1 (08/05) : Shrines, Shrubs & Scribbles, oh my!
notes.content:
Join our discord to hear about new Dev Diaries as soon as they go up!

Hi! Hello!
If you’re not familiar with Cat Cafe Manager, first of all, congratulations on taking the plunge and clicking on a dev diary for something you knew nothing about, and second of all...
Cat Cafe Manager is our chill business sim in which you run your very own cat cafe, being developed by us: Roost Games!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/d0e1a2f092d0aee7dc4919031f32ae94bfb2c31d.png

For those of you that’d like to get a closer peek at the game’s developments so far and going forward, this dev diary is for you! One of us will write one up every couple of weeks. So lie down, get the closest human to scratch you behind the ear, and read on.

Announcing Cat Cafe Manager
We’ve worked on Cat Cafe Manager since the start of 2020, and decided to share our progress with the world last week Tuesday the 28th. In case you missed it:
[previewyoutube=hDVQxq06J5o;full][/previewyoutube]
For all of you that pressed heart-shaped buttons, retweeted, commented, wishlisted, or decided to hang out on our Discord, thank you so much!! We honestly expected to release our little trailer into the empty void of the internet and not hear much at all. It’s been incredibly invigorating for us to see the positive response Cat Cafe Manager got!

Let's talk about what we've been working on since the announcement.


Current developments: Shrines, Shrubs & Scribbles, oh my!

Carmen, Roost Games’ art & animation powerhouse, has spent last week animating a unique sprite for one of our Regulars: Bonner.

Regulars are unique customers that will regularly visit your cat cafe. If they enjoy your cafe you can start conversations with them to slowly build up your friendship!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/b457512ac797605d14aba02974100bc8a33e5193.gif

Bonner is the town’s old ferryman. He loves adventure, applauding a movie’s credits, and his husband Gavin (who will hopefully be a regular visitor as well!). Different regulars enjoy being with different cats, and Bonner particularly likes nimble cats who like putting up a good (play)fight.

Speaking of Regulars, Rick (surprise, that's me!) has been writing dialogue for Finley, an up-and-coming young musician that likes to work on her music at your cat cafe. As your friendship develops, you’ll get to learn more about her struggles, and maybe even help her...

Conversations with Regulars include branching choices, built using our dialogue editor.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/9b3d94eb1f4944e4816188544ffb4d986854c508.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/ab3e4022f0b2a00a21da248e0b5b90b78e56634f.png

Carmen has also been expanding the nature assets we have as well, so the shrubbery and trees around your cafe are a bit more varied. They will also be used in a very exciting new feature! Read on…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/ab7743e4c19749f3c41f867015c72f49eaf45e1e.png

The Shrine
Caterwaul Way, the countryside village you’re moving to at the start of your cat cafe story, is home to many old mysteries. One such mystery is the decrepit shrine to an ancient cat god that stands deep within the woods close by the town.

A mysterious figure will ask you to help them restore the old shrine, and it's up to you to decide which parts to restore first. The cats seem to really like it when you renovate this old shrine, but you'll have to work hard to convince all the villagers of Caterwaul Way to help!

Rutger, our programmer, has been working hard to build out this big new feature.
The shrine is in early alpha, and not really at a place where we have a lot to show off yet, but we’re really excited to share it with you in the coming weeks!!


That’s it for right now, cool cats.
If you’re interested in Cat Cafe Manager, please consider wishlisting the game right here on Steam. It’s honestly a tremendous help to us! If you’d like to keep up with these dev diaries, consider coming to hang out on our Discord!

Thanks so so much, and see you next time!
Rick
